M07.intro: This module is the record of every person in your organisation. You hire people with a guided wizard, find them in the Directory and the Employees register, and see and change everything about one person on their Employee 360.
M07.why: Attendance, leave, payroll, letters and exit all read the employee record. A wrong position, manager or date here flows into approvals, pay and statutory returns.
M07.who: Tenant Super Admin and Tenant HR Admin hold every employee permission. HR Manager hires, transfers and changes lifecycle states but does not see bank or statutory numbers. HR Executive hires and updates records. Payroll Admin sees and updates bank and statutory details. Managers and Auditors only view.
M07.where: People › Lifecycle › Employees (and the Lifecycle desk, Workforce uploads, Bank details uploads, Bulk runs, Business partners); People › Directory; People › My team › Team calendar.
objectives: Hire a new employee end to end with the hire wizard, including the duplicate check and the employee code series.
Read and act on an Employee 360: its views, record tabs, Action and More menus, and masked sensitive data.
Tell an edit of the current record from an effective-dated change, and use uploads and bulk runs safely.
depends_on: M03 Organisation structure: companies, locations, departments, designations, grades and the employee code series must exist before you hire.
M05 Users, access and integrations: roles give the employee.* permissions; sign-ins are managed under Users.
M06 Workflows and policies: the confirmation and exit policies and notification rules act on the people you hire.
M12 Compensation and salary structures: a hire has no salary until you assign one.

people/directory.purpose: A people finder: cards or a table of everyone you may see, with a quick preview drawer. The full register with bulk actions and exports stays in Employees.
people/directory.when: When you need to find a person, their manager or their work contact details quickly.
elements: Name, employee ID or work email. Each word must match the start of a name, the employee code or the work e-mail.
Narrow the list or group it by department, location or manager. Shown when you can see more than 8 people.
Switch the view. Recently changed lists joiners, moves, reporting changes and exits of the last 30 days.
Opens the Employees register with its filters, views and bulk actions.
Table columns: employee ID, name, role (designation), department, location, manager and lifecycle status.
Select a name: Open profile, Message, Org map, Pin, plus manager, work e-mail, work phone, With us for and Employee ID.
In the drawer: Transfer or promote, Change manager, Change lifecycle state, Start onboarding or Start a workflow.
people/directory.permission: employee.view shows everyone in your access scope. Without it a person sees only their manager, their direct reports and themselves.
people/directory.depends: Employees with a current position (department, location).
people/directory.limits: Alumni and people marked Not Joined are left out unless you pick that status. The list shows 24 at a time (Show more, up to 500). In the example organisation 22 of 23 people show; the alumnus is hidden.

people/team-calendar.purpose: One month of people events for the people you look after: birthdays, anniversaries, joiners, probation ends, leave, last working days and more. Read only.
people/team-calendar.when: When you plan the month: who is away, who joins or leaves, whose probation ends.
elements: Chips for 16 event kinds (Birthdays, Work anniversaries, New joiners, Last working day, Leave …). None pressed shows all.
My team or Organisation. Shown only when you have both audiences.
The month and the number of events in it, for example November 2026 with 16 events.
Date, person, and the event with its detail, such as the leave type and dates or "Probation ends".
people/team-calendar.permission: Organisation view: employee.update, servicedesk.agent or onboarding.manage. My team: your own employee record has direct reports.
people/team-calendar.depends: Which event kinds each audience sees is set in Setup → Access rights → Calendar access.
people/team-calendar.limits: Holidays are not shown on this calendar, although the subheading mentions them. Private leave shows only as "Away". At most 500 records per event kind per month.

people/employees.purpose: The employee register: search, filter and save views, run reports and act on many employees at once. Every row opens that person's Employee 360.
people/employees.when: Daily, to find records, check groups (new hires, probation, notice) and start bulk actions.
elements: Ready views: New hires (not joined yet), On probation, Serving notice, Without a background check, Exited and alumni; save your own.
Ready-made reports such as the employee master, headcount by department, new joiners, probation due and employees without a manager.
Runs a bulk action on every employee matching the filters. You must filter or search first.
Step wizards: Change manager, Invite to sign in, Send password reset links.
Shows the employees as cards with the fields you choose.
Columns; more (Type, Work email, Background check, Added on) can be switched on.
View, Edit, Not eligible for rehire
Row actions. Not eligible for rehire appears on exited or alumni rows for exit.manage holders.
people/employees.permission: employee.view to see; employee.create for Hire employee; employee.update for Edit; bulk.run plus each action's own permission for bulk actions.
people/employees.limits: Ticked-row bulk actions are Initiate exit, Start onboarding, Initiate background check, Send e-mail, Generate letters, Start clearance, Complete exit, Change manager, Invite to sign in, Send password reset links. Export appears only when employee upload and export is switched on for your organisation (ask PeopleOS support).

people/employees--create.purpose: The hire wizard: Person, Identity numbers, Employment, Position, Manager, then optional Address, Family, Bank, Previous employment, Other details, Sign-in and Review. It creates the employee in one go.
people/employees--create.when: Each time someone new joins (or will join). Use Rehire / reactivate on the Employee 360 for someone who worked here before.
elements: Steps in a rail; optional steps say Optional. Steps you have no right for (Identity numbers, Bank, Sign-in) are hidden.
After Person: a definite match (same personal e-mail, personal phone or work e-mail) stops you; same name and date of birth warns you.
Appears only when an earlier employee matches. If they are not eligible for rehire you must confirm and give a reason.
Auto-generate takes the next code of the company's series (shown as Next code in the series); Enter manually only if the series allows it.
Lists everything you filled in, with the Reason for change, before Create.
After saving: what was created, what was left for later, and Next steps (Open the Employee 360, Start onboarding, Documents …).

fields.label: Work phone: country code

procedures.title: Hire a new employee with the hire wizard (worked example)
procedures.before: Company, organisation values and the company's code series exist. You hold employee.create. Example (illustrative): Riya Sen joins Demo Technologies on 1 Dec 2026.
steps: People › Lifecycle › Employees › Hire employee. The page Hire employee opens at 01 Person.
Leave Existing person blank. Enter First name Riya, Last name Sen, Date of birth, Gender, Personal email and Personal phone. Click Next.
PeopleOS compares personal e-mail and phone (definite) and name plus date of birth (possible). A red message stops you; amber asks you to review.
Enter PAN (ABCDE1234F format) and Aadhaar reference if you have them, or leave blank and add later. Click Next.
Appears only if the person worked here before. To bring them back on the same record, cancel and use Rehire / reactivate.
Company: Demo Technologies. Joining date: 1 Dec 2026. Leave Probation end date blank. Employee code: Auto-generate shows DT-0002. Add Work email.
Location Bangalore, Department Engineering, Team Platform, Designation Software Engineer, Grade, Level, Employment type Full-time, Work mode Hybrid.
Line manager: Amit Verma (EMP00002). Optionally HR business partner: Neha Kapoor. Add a Reason for change, e.g. New hire, offer of 10 Oct.
Add an address, family members, a bank account, earlier employers and Other details (Laptop asset tag), or skip them for later.
Switch on Create a sign-in and send the invitation if Riya should have access from day one. It needs the Work email.
Check every value and the reason, then click Create. If any part is refused, a Not hired message names it and nothing is saved.
The panel lists Created (Employee DT-0002, Line manager, …), Left for later and Next steps. Open the Employee 360.

troubleshooting: Red message "This person already exists" after the Person step
Another person has the same personal e-mail, personal phone or work e-mail.
Select that person in Existing person, or correct the details. Someone who worked here before returns with Rehire / reactivate.
Amber message "Possible duplicate person"
Same first name, last name and date of birth as someone on file.
Check the named record; continue only if it is a different person.
"Employee code already in use"
The code typed by hand is taken by any employee of any company.
Go back to Employment and choose another code or Auto-generate.
"Codes cannot be typed by hand for this company"
The company's code series allows only generated codes.
Choose Auto-generate, or change the series in People Setup → Employee code series.
"Not hired" with a reason
One part (seat, starting state, bank, returning check…) was refused; the hire is one transaction.
Nothing was saved. Fix the step named in the message and create again.
"Your organisation needs the employee's … on file before this is entered"
A document type is linked as required with PAN, Aadhaar or bank.
Leave the field blank, hire, upload the document on the 360, then add the value.
"A sign-in needs the work e-mail (Employment step)."
The Sign-in step was switched on without a valid work e-mail, or the e-mail is used by another user.
Enter a unique Work email, or invite later from People › Employees.
The manager I want is not in the list
Only employed people in your access scope are offered: not pre-joiners, exited, alumni or not joined, and never the person themselves.
Mark the manager as joined first, or ask for a wider access scope.
"The new position must start after the current one (date)."
Transfer / promote on or before the current position's start date, e.g. the same day as the hire or an earlier move.
Use an effective date after that start date.
"A position already starts on …; positions cannot overlap."
A future-dated position is already on file.
Use a date after it, or correct that position first.
"… already reports to this employee; that would create a loop."
The chosen manager is in the employee's own reporting chain.
Pick another manager or change the other line first.
"An employee cannot move from X to Y."
That lifecycle step is not allowed (e.g. Joined to Confirmed).
Go through the allowed step first (Joined → Probation → Confirmed).
No Bank tab or Statutory details on the 360
You lack employee.sensitive.view, or Profile access hides the section from your audience.
Ask an administrator for the permission (M05).
"Apply a filter or a search first" on Act on all matching
A bulk action on all records needs the register narrowed.
Filter or search, then start again.
Bank upload row: "The account number was turned into a number like 5.01E+13"
The spreadsheet changed the number format.
Format the column as Text, re-enter the numbers and upload again.

M08.intro: This module covers everything between the hire and the exit: the days before joining, onboarding plans and their templates, background checks, probation and confirmation, transfers and promotions, contracts, and the letters and documents you send to employees.
M08.why: Missed onboarding steps, unconfirmed probations and undocumented transfers create compliance gaps, wrong approvals and unhappy joiners. Letters issued without control can commit the organisation.
M08.who: Tenant Super Admin, Tenant HR Admin and HR Manager run every process here (onboarding.manage, bgv.manage, employee.position, employee.lifecycle, letter.*, document.share). HR Executives view onboarding and checks and complete their own tasks. Managers and employees complete the onboarding tasks assigned to them. Auditors view.
M08.where: People › Lifecycle › Upcoming joiners, Onboarding, Onboarding templates, Background checks, Confirmation reviews, Transfer requests, Contracts, Letters, Letter templates, Letter schedules, Signing authorities, Shared documents, Published documents.
objectives: Prepare upcoming joiners and run onboarding plans built from templates, including document collection and background checks.
Decide confirmation reviews and handle transfers, promotions and manager changes with the right dates and approvals.
Set up letter templates and signing authorities, then generate, approve, issue and schedule letters and share documents.
depends_on: M07 Employees and the employee profile: every process here starts from an employee record and its Employee 360.
M06 Workflows and policies: confirmation, transfer and exit policies set probation months, notice, allowed changes and letter hooks; notification rules decide who is told.
M04 Masters and configuration: document types, option lists and workforce reasons.
M12 Compensation: salary letters and the salary annexure read the approved compensation.

N day(s) before joining, or On preboarding when blank.

M09.intro: This module takes a leaver from resignation or an initiated exit through notice, clearance and the full and final settlement to completion, and keeps them in touch afterwards as alumni with their own portal.
M09.why: An exit touches pay, assets, access and legal documents. A missed clearance, a wrong last working day or an unapproved settlement means money or company property lost and a login left open.
M09.who: Tenant Super Admin, Tenant HR Admin and HR Manager hold every exit and alumni permission (exit.manage, exit.settle, exit.clear, exit.interview, alumni.manage). Managers clear the stages they own (exit.clear). Employees resign (exit.resign). Auditors view. Alumni use the alumni portal.
M09.where: People › Lifecycle › Exit cases, Clearances, Clearance checklists, Exit insights, Alumni. Employees resign from My Day.
objectives: Start an exit (resignation or initiated), set the notice and last working day, and handle acceptance, relaxation and withdrawal.
Run clearance with its five stages and checklists, including the asset return rule, then calculate, approve and pay the full and final settlement.
Complete the exit, create the alumni profile and serve alumni requests, and read the exit insights.
depends_on: M07 Employees and the employee profile: the exit starts from an employed person; Initiate exit is also on the Employee 360.
M06 Workflows and policies: the exit (separation) policy sets the notice period, notice recovery, checklists, interviews and letters.
M08 Joining, changes and letters: relieving and experience letters are letter templates.
M11 Leave and M13 Payroll: leave balances are encashed and the final month's salary is calculated in the settlement.
M18 Assets: assets still held block the Asset clearance stage unless a recovery is recorded.

procedures.title: Initiate an exit (HR)
procedures.before: exit.manage. The employee is employed and not already serving notice.
steps: People › Lifecycle › Exit cases › Initiate exit (or Employee 360 › Action › Initiate exit).
Employee and Type. For Termination, Absconding or Death the notice is 0 and the last day is today.
Resignation / decision date. Check Notice days: it is pre-filled with 30 and replaces the policy's notice unless you change it.
Knowledge transfer to, Eligible for rehire, Reason.
The message gives the case number and last working day.
procedures.result: An exit case in Serving notice, the employee in Notice Period, five clearance stages ready and the manager told.

procedures.title: Handle an employee's resignation
procedures.before: The employee resigned from My Day (Resign: Reason for leaving, optional Requested last working day).
steps: Exit cases › Views › Resignations, then Open.
Notice days come from the exit policy (60 in the example organisation). A requested last day counts only if earlier than the notice end.
Accept / reject resignation appears only when acceptance is required; otherwise the notice runs at once.
Change last working day (reason required) or Notice relaxation (days not recovered, reason required).
Withdraw resignation with a reason: the case is Withdrawn, open stages become not applicable and the employee is Active.
procedures.result: A resignation with the right last day and notice shortfall, or a withdrawn case.

procedures.title: Run clearance
procedures.before: The case is Serving notice. Stage owners hold exit.clear (or HR clears with exit.manage).
steps: Exit case › Start clearance (or wait: it starts 7 days before the last working day). Owners are notified.
Clearances › Mine to clear › Clear: tick the checklist, Amount to recover in F&F, Remarks.
Asset clearance is refused while assets are held unless an amount to recover is entered.
Block with remarks tells HR; Reopen when solved.
HR closes a stage that does not apply, with remarks.
procedures.result: All five stages cleared or not applicable; the case moves to Settlement with a draft settlement.

procedures.title: Set up your own clearance checklist
procedures.before: exit.manage; an exit policy you can edit (M06).
steps: Clearance checklists › New clearance checklist: Name, Status Active, Description.
Add an item per task: Stage, Item, Due (days before the last day), Mandatory.
In the exit (separation) policy choose it under Map clearance checklist and publish.
procedures.result: New exits get your items for each stage the checklist covers.

procedures.title: Calculate, approve and pay the full and final settlement
procedures.before: exit.settle. Leave balances and the final month's attendance are up to date.
steps: Exit case › Full & final › Start settlement (or the draft made after clearance) and Calculate.
Salary to the last day, leave encashment, gratuity, recoveries (notice, assets, loans, advances) and expense reimbursements.
Add line: Earning or Deduction, Name (e.g. notice buy-out, bonus), Amount, Note.
Approve freezes the lines and posts the encashed days to the leave ledger.
After paying, Mark paid with the Payment reference; loans and advances are closed.
procedures.result: An approved (then paid) settlement whose net the employee is told about.

procedures.title: Complete the exit and create the alumni profile
procedures.before: All stages cleared; settlement approved (or no dues). exit.manage.
steps: Exit case › Complete exit; read any hand-over warning; tick Complete without an approved settlement only if there are no dues.
Exit completed: the employee is Exited on the last working day and their login is suspended.
Generate letter: relieving and experience letters; approve and issue them in Letters.
Create alumni profile: Personal email, Phone, Enable alumni portal login, Consented to be contacted.
procedures.result: A closed exit, issued relieving letters and an alumni profile with portal access if chosen.

calculations.title: Full and final settlement of Vikram Singh (real, example organisation)
calculations.intro: EXIT-2026-00001: resignation 1 Sep 2026, last working day 1 Oct 2026, annual CTC 4,80,000 (40,000 a month). All figures are from the example organisation; the settlement is Approved, not yet paid.
explain: Salary to the last day
October was not paid in payroll, so it is paid here: 1 paid day of 31 calendar days, each full monthly amount × 1 ÷ 31.
Monthly amounts
Basic = 40% of monthly CTC; HRA = 50% of basic; conveyance 1,600 fixed; special = CTC − basic − HRA − conveyance − employer PF (1,920).
Leave encashment
Encashable paid leave only (Earned leave): 19.25 days available × (basic 16,000 ÷ 30 = 533.33). Basis set by your organisation (basic).
Gratuity
No line: the gratuity rule maintained by PeopleOS found the establishment not covered (at most 5 employees, below the threshold of 10).
Notice
Notice 30 days, served 30 (1 Sep to 1 Oct): no shortfall, so no recovery line.
Other recoveries
No assets to recover, loans or expense advances; lines of 0.00 are never added.
Where you see it
Exit case › Full & final › Breakdown. Approval reduced the Earned leave balance by 19.25 days.

calculations.title: Notice shortfall recovery
calculations.intro: Days are real: Omar Farooq (EXIT-2026-00002) resigned on 16 Nov 2026 with 60 days' notice (exit policy) and a last working day of 16 Dec 2026. The pay figure is illustrative.
explain: Formula
Shortfall = notice − days served − relaxation, never below 0; recovery = shortfall × (monthly gross ÷ 30, rounded to paise).
When
Resignations only, when your organisation recovers notice and the exit policy sets no other rule.
Reduce it
Notice relaxation, or an earlier last working day agreed with the employee, changes the shortfall.
Important
With no salary on file (as for Omar in the example organisation) no recovery line is added.

warnings.title: Check Notice days when you initiate an exit
warnings.headline: Initiate exit pre-fills 30 days from the organisation setting, not the exit policy.
warnings.body: The value you leave in Notice days is used. In the example organisation the policy says 60 days. The Resign window also tells employees 30 days, while their notice comes from the policy.
points: Clear or correct Notice days before saving.
Employees cannot set a later last day than the end of notice.
Notice buy-out in the policy has no automatic effect: add it with Add line.

warnings.title: Who can clear each stage
warnings.headline: A stage owner needs exit.clear; otherwise HR clears it.
warnings.body: IT and Asset stages go to the Asset Admin role, Finance to Payroll Admin, HR to Tenant HR Admin, and Manager to the leaver's manager. In the example organisation Asset Admin and Payroll Admin do not hold exit.clear.
points: Grant exit.clear to the owner roles (M05), or clear the stages as HR.
Mandatory checklist items are not enforced: check them yourself.
Assets still held block the Asset clearance stage unless you record an amount to recover.

warnings.title: The order of settlement and completion
warnings.headline: Approve the settlement before completing; nothing stops completion before the last day.
warnings.body: A settlement can be calculated and approved before clearance finishes. Complete exit needs every stage cleared and an approved settlement, but it can run before the last working day and suspends the login at once.
points: Complete the exit on or after the last working day.
Once the settlement is approved, the last working day and relaxation cannot change.
Recalculate if the final month's payroll was closed after calculating.

warnings.headline: After Complete exit, use Create alumni profile.
warnings.body: The profile, the Alumni state and the portal login come only from Create alumni profile. The portal needs the person to have a sign-in.

troubleshooting: "An exit is already in progress for this employee."
An open case exists.
Open that case from Exit cases.
"Only current employees can be exited."
The person is a pre-joiner, exited or alumni.
For a pre-joiner use Mark as not joining.
Initiate exit is missing on the Employee 360
The person is in Notice Period, has an open case or is not employed.
Open the existing case.
"Clearance has not started for this exit."
The case is still Serving notice.
Click Start clearance, or wait until 7 days before the last day.
Clear and Block are not shown
Clearance has not started, or you lack exit.clear or do not own the stage.
Start clearance, or ask HR to clear it.
"Assets still in custody: … Take them back, or record a recoverable amount."
Assets are still assigned to the leaver.
Return them in Assets, or enter Amount to recover in F&F.
"All clearance stages must be cleared first."
A stage is pending or blocked.
Clear it or mark it Not applicable.
"The full & final settlement must be approved first."
Completion needs an approved settlement.
Approve it, or tick Complete without an approved settlement when there are no dues.
"An approved settlement cannot be recalculated."
Lines are frozen after approval.
Settle differences outside, or before approving next time.
"Payroll for … was closed after this settlement was calculated …"
The final month was paid in payroll after you calculated.
Recalculate, then approve.
"The full & final settlement is already approved." when changing the last day
Dates are frozen with the settlement.
Change dates before approving.
"Only a resignation that is still open can be withdrawn."
Not a resignation, or already in settlement or completed.
Withdrawal is possible only in notice or clearance.
"Complete the exit before creating the alumni profile."
The case is still open.
Complete the exit first.
Alumni request: "No active letter template of that type."
No active template for that letter type; the request stays Approved.
Activate a template, generate the letter in Letters, then Mark delivered.
An alumnus cannot open the portal
No sign-in, portal not enabled, or no Alumni role.
Invite them from Users and check the profile's Portal.
checklist: Case started
Right type, resignation date, notice days and last working day.
Notice
Shortfall checked; relaxation or an earlier last day agreed and recorded.
Hand-over
Knowledge transfer named; team moved to a new manager; roles handed over.
Clearance
All five stages cleared or not applicable; assets returned or recovery recorded.
Exit interview
Recorded by the leaver or HR.
Settlement
Calculated after the last attendance and leave; manual lines added; approved; paid with a reference.
Letters
Relieving and experience letters approved and issued.
Completion
Complete exit on or after the last working day (login suspended).
Alumni
Alumni profile created with portal access if wanted.
summary: Every exit is a case: Serving notice → Clearance → Settlement → Completed.
Notice comes from the exit policy; check Notice days when HR initiates an exit.
Five clearance stages; unreturned assets block the Asset stage unless a recovery is recorded.
Full and final adds salary to the last day, encashment, gratuity, recoveries and reimbursements.
Complete exit needs all stages cleared and an approved settlement, and suspends the login.
Create the alumni profile yourself; alumni request letters through the portal.
